package.author: tianma-if
package.description: AI 原生知识库与印象笔记 / Obsidian 替代方案，支持多端瞬时同步与原生 MCP。

en-US.description: AI-native notes and knowledge base with instant sync and MCP.
en-US.longDescription:
EdgeEver is a modern, open-source notes and knowledge base workspace. It preserves the classic, high-efficiency three-pane productivity workflow (Tree View, Note List, Editor) while offering an open data architecture and seamless AI Agent integration for complete ownership and smart productivity.
EdgeEver can run within Cloudflare's free quotas with no server purchase or VPS maintenance. Users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server can deploy the same application with Docker.
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Import official flomo HTML ZIP exports with content, tags, timestamps and attachments through the unified import flow. Thanks @sivdead (#834; related to #794).
- Create notes for standalone Obsidian attachments by default, simplify import notices and prioritize errors that block import.
- Restore sharing for visual notes and display shared infographics correctly.
- Unify interface and note font selectors, and simplify the feedback entry across clients.
- Refresh product previews, improve website navigation and image previews, and update contact pages. The public Demo now redirects HTTP to HTTPS.
Related Issue: #844
贡献者 / Contributors：@yulei666

zh-CN.author: tianma-if
zh-CN.description: AI 原生知识库与印象笔记 / Obsidian 替代方案，支持多端瞬时同步与原生 MCP。
zh-CN.longDescription:
EdgeEver 是一款现代化的开源笔记与个人知识库工作区。它保留经典高效的三栏工作区体验（目录树、笔记列表、编辑写作），同时具备完全开放的数据架构与原生 AI Agent 联动能力，让个人知识沉淀更轻量、更自由。
EdgeEver 可以免费运行在 Cloudflare 配额内，无需购买或维护服务器；希望使用 VPS、NAS 或家庭服务器的用户，也可以通过 Docker 部署同一套应用。
zh-CN.name: EdgeEver
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- 支持通过统一导入流程导入 flomo 官方 HTML ZIP 导出，保留正文、标签、时间和附件。感谢 @sivdead（#834，关联 #794）。
- 默认将 Obsidian 独立附件导入为笔记，精简常规导入提示并优先显示阻断错误。
- 恢复可视化笔记的分享入口，并正确展示分享的信息图。
- 统一界面与笔记的字体选择体验，并精简各客户端的问题反馈入口。
- 更新产品预览，改进官网导航、图片预览与联系页面；公开 Demo 的 HTTP 访问自动跳转到 HTTPS。
关联 Issue：#844
